0-preflight.detail: Initially blocked on the bot token; cleared when the user ran `appmixer test auth login`. auth.js verified live - validate() and requestProfileInfo() both returned real data.

1-build.detail: 13 components. eslint exit 0, validate.js --connector telegram 0 failures 0 warnings (25 validators).

2-review.detail: 3 findings fixed: dynamic output options lacked example/nested properties, unused quota rule removed, GetFile download errors normalized.

3a-cli-tests.detail: 10 of 13 components tested via `appmixer test component` against the live bot. 10 pass. 1 defect found and fixed (GetFile stream -> arraybuffer, commit fcad6b96). The remaining 3 components are not reachable from the CLI and are covered by E2E instead.

notTestableViaCli.SendPhoto / SendDocument multipart uploa: appmixer test component uses an ephemeral per-invocation file store, so a file saved by one invocation is gone in the next. The multipart branch of lib.sendMedia is covered by SendDocument in the media E2E flow; SendPhoto is driven with a URL there, so its own upload branch is exercised only through that shared helper.
notTestableViaCli.AnswerCallbackQuery: needs a real callback_query_id, which only a human button press produces.

3b-e2e.detail: 5 flows generated, `appmixer e2e validate` passes (26 validators), all imported with the account bound. All 5 verified in the E2E success store.
passed: E2E Telegram - media (covers the multipart upload path)
E2E Telegram - new message trigger (plugin webhook verified end to end)
E2E Telegram - callback query trigger (NewCallbackQuery + AnswerCallbackQuery verified with a real button press)

4-ship.detail: Branch pushed to origin (petrolivka fork); PR opened against Appmixer-ai/appmixer-connectors.

webhookVerification.routeVerified: A real bot message was delivered to the plugin endpoint inside a genuine Telegram update envelope. With the correct X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token the trigger fired and the flow passed; the wrong-secret POST produced no second delivery (a duplicate would have made the cleanup DeleteMessage fail).

notes: E2E Assert clauses render a modifier binding as a string, so a boolean expectation never matches - it fails with the confusing 'expected true to equal true'. Write "true"/"false" as strings.

Review feedback from vtalas addressed: stray file_0.jpg removed, dynamic outPort source uses the "dummy" literal, all five flows carry a notes sticky, upload limits are per-method, and ForwardMessage declares forward_origin.
